name: HJDataset: Large Dataset of Historical Japanese Documents with Complex Layouts
description: HJDataset is a large-scale benchmark dataset for document layout analysis, region segmentation, and reading order extraction in complex historical Japanese documents. Created by researchers from the Dell Lab at Harvard University and presented at the CVPR 2020 Workshop on Text and Documents in the Deep Learning Era, HJDataset contains over 250,000 layout element annotations of 7 distinct structural types. The dataset captures unique layout challenges in Asian document heritage—including vertical text orientations, mixed reading directions, dense multi-column tables, headers, and historical Kanji typography. In addition to bounding boxes and pixel-level masks, annotations encode hierarchical document structures and reading orders.
